title: Cancellation of a quasicategorical equivalence
statement: Use quasicategories, simplicial functors and coherent natural equivalences from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the Joyal model structure and its quasicategory characterization from [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure] and [lem-coef-joyal-quasicategory-characterizations]. Let $X,Y$ be quasicategories and let $f:X\to Y$, $r:Y\to X$ be simplicial functors. If $f$ is a categorical equivalence and there is a coherent natural equivalence $rf\simeq1_X$, then $r$ is a categorical equivalence. Consequently $r$ admits a coherent quasi-inverse and is fully faithful and essentially surjective.

source.place: The cancellation subargument in the simplex-relative inverse proof: $rf\simeq1_X$, two-out-of-three with $f$, and the Joyal characterization of the resulting equivalence.
